cards.back: Trying to recall information from memory.

cards.front: When should you look at an answer during retrieval practice?
cards.source_quote: A retrieval attempt happens before looking at the answer.

cards.front: How does spaced practice organize study sessions?
cards.back: It distributes study sessions over time.

cards.front: What does a review schedule decide?

cards.front: What does an atomic card test?
cards.source_quote: An atomic card tests one clear idea.
